general_items.title: Singapore and Sweden deepen clean-energy cooperation
general_items.summary: EMA announced deeper cooperation with Sweden on hydrogen, ammonia and cross-border electricity technologies. This extends the existing partnership rather than announcing a completed energy project.
general_items.caveat: Primary EMA release dated 20 October was retrieved through search; direct-page access failed. Cooperation is exploratory, not evidence of delivered capacity or lower bills.

general_items.title: Police disclose malware-enabled social-ad scam losses
general_items.summary: Police disclosed at least 62 cases and S$989,000 in losses since April involving malicious apps promoted through fake social-media advertisements. The disclosure is new; the losses accumulated over several months.
general_items.caveat: Original police release directly inspected; issued 20 October at 16:00 SGT. These are cumulative losses, not a single-day total.

general_items.title: India–New Zealand free-trade agreement enters into force
general_items.summary: The India–New Zealand trade agreement entered into force on 20 October. Indian goods gain duty-free access under its terms; exporters must still meet relevant origin and documentation requirements.
general_items.caveat: Entry into force is the new milestone, not the original signing. Customs and MFAT independently confirm the effective date.

general_items.title: Rubio and Jaishankar discuss energy and defence in Mumbai
general_items.summary: Rubio and Jaishankar met in Mumbai on 20 October. The US readout highlighted energy diversification and defence and civil nuclear cooperation. These were discussions, not newly verified supply contracts.
general_items.caveat: Completed meeting is a material update to the earlier visit preview. State Department readout retrieved through Forth syndication and corroborated by Akashvani; no signed energy deal claimed.

general_items.title: GM reports quarterly earnings and authorizes $20bn repurchases
general_items.summary: GM reported US$50.0 billion in revenue and US$3.3 billion in quarterly net income. Its new US$20 billion buyback authorisation permits future repurchases; it does not mean that amount has already been spent.
general_items.caveat: Original investor-relations 8-K downloaded and inspected. Adjusted cash-flow guidance is a non-GAAP measure; repurchases remain discretionary.

general_items.title: Toh wins second bronze; Wong sets national record
general_items.summary: Toh Wei Soong won 100m freestyle S7 bronze, his second medal. Wong Zhi Wei set a 400m freestyle S13 national record and met the Paralympic minimum qualifying standard, which does not guarantee selection.
general_items.caveat: Original Sport Singapore report directly inspected. Medal colour and qualifying-standard distinction were checked against the article body.

conditions.caveat: 24-hour PSI is a rolling measure. The forecast is not the same as the current observation; rainfall does not guarantee haze clearance.

ai_items.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to coordinate drug-development work
ai_items.summary: OpenAI says it acquired Orchestra Bio, which coordinates biopharma development workflows, and plans to combine it with Rosalind. The immediate story is operational coordination, not proof that AI has shortened clinical trials or produced an approved medicine.
ai_items.caveat: Primary page says has acquired despite URL slug to-acquire. No demonstrated patient-outcome or regulatory-approval benefit established.

ai_items.title: Anthropic reports lab-tested scorpion-toxin protein binders, not an antivenom
ai_items.summary: Anthropic reports that 17 of 211 tested protein designs met binding criteria against four scorpion toxins. The supervised design campaign included human follow-up prompts. Binding is not neutralisation; cell, animal and further efficacy/safety work remain. No antivenom was produced.
ai_items.caveat: The campaign used an initial prompt, four follow-ups and human supervision. 17 binders each against one of four toxins; five toxins targeted; no qualifying Brazil Ts1 binder. No cell neutralisation or mouse efficacy result; recombinant binding alone is not therapeutic efficacy.

ai_items.title: Mistral releases Voxtral 3 speech models and voice-agent SDK
ai_items.timestamp_precision: minute; exact displayed original-post timestamp of independent evaluation, not claimed as Mistral launch time
ai_items.primary_date: Launch available by 2026-10-21 00:53 SGT; page has no separately visible publication timestamp. Embedded benchmark states generated 2026-10-20.
ai_items.summary: Voxtral 3 combines new transcription and speech models with a voice-agent SDK. Mistral offers API and self-deployment options. Artificial Analysis independently reports Small Transcribe 3 third on its speech-to-text index; rankings do not establish performance in a particular contact centre.
ai_items.caveat: Transcription supports 50-plus languages; TTS 35-plus languages/50-plus dialects. Language coverage varies by component. Vendor speed and workflow claims are not independently demonstrated production outcomes here.

ai_items.title: Perplexity launches fully local Computer mode on supported Macs
ai_items.timestamp_precision: second; original post displays 23:48 Oct20; quoted rendered DOM timestamp 1792511293000 independently converted to Singapore time
ai_items.summary: Perplexity says its Mac app can now run both model and agent locally, with permission to access files/apps. Available to Pro, Max and Enterprise; supported Apple-silicon hardware and 36GB-plus memory recommended. Cloud escalation remains optional for current information or external services. This is a vendor launch, not an independent security audit.
ai_items.caveat: 36GB is recommended, not stated as a universal hard minimum. Local inference does not imply all app integrations or every workflow stay offline.

selected_episode.title: The Bumpy Road To AGI — With Kevin Roose

podcast.summary: In the October15 Big Technology conversation, Roose argues that shared conviction helps explain organisational persistence and willingness to make long-term bets. This is his interpretation, not established causation. Editorial application: agree on a specific AI workflow outcome while keeping evidence and dissent welcome.

segment_references.theme: Roose explicitly attributes organisational persistence to shared belief, with Google internal-memo contrast.

podcast.caveat: Interpretation attributed to Kevin Roose; business application is editorial, not a reported deployment. Transcript may contain errors.

expert.title: Learn from the structure already in data
expert.summary: LeCun and Misra explain learning by predicting hidden parts of data. Editorial application: distinguish broad pretraining from validation for a specific workflow.

fact.title: Blue light around a Martian sunset
fact.claim: Martian sunsets can show a blue glow because fine atmospheric dust lets blue light penetrate more efficiently than longer wavelengths. NASA rover imagery documents the effect.
fact.caveat: The glow is concentrated near the Sun; not every sunset has the same intensity.
